trials.title: A Study to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of CBL-514 Injection for Reducing Subcutaneous Fat

primaryOutcomes.measure: Percentage of participants with at least a 2-grade improvement on Patient Reported Abdominal Fat Rating Scale (PR-AFRS) and Clinician Reported Abdominal Fat Rating Scale (CR-AFRS) in the CBL-514 group versus the placebo group.

trials.commentary: Ph 3, randomized, double-blind. Targeting 320 patients. Started Sep 2026, primary completion Jul 2027. Record history not collected yet; comparisons are vs first seen.
